summary: Design inclusive farmer-facing advisory services, select channels and measure adoption. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Digital agricultural advisory service design helps extension teams plan farmer-facing support across digital channels. For extension managers, programme teams and agricultural service providers, the training covers mapping farmer journeys, comparing SMS, IVR and radio, and creating accessible advisory content. Learners also develop partner responsibility plans, adoption measures and feedback workflows using service blueprints and a Theory of Change; AI-assisted content and data collection are considered at an operational, non-technical level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for planning, delivering, funding or evaluating farmer-facing digital advisory services across agriculture and rural development.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural extension, rural development or programme delivery is expected. No coding or software development is required. Bring a laptop with access to KoboToolbox and either Excel or spreadsheet software such as Excel; the course uses sample service-monitoring data.
